- **Symmetry Misinterpretation:** Assuming that symmetry-reduced case sequences uniquely define the interpolant path is incorrect [S1, book].

The claim states that assuming symmetry-reduced case sequences uniquely define the interpolant path is incorrect. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly supports this by stating: 'it will not be true that the paths can simply be counted in a symmetry-reduced finite state machine.'
